drill down.sql
content:
/* Drill down  */
SELECT W.NAME windowname,
       TAB.NAME tabname,
       C.NAME columnname,
       C.COLUMNNAME colid,
       F.DISPLAYLOGIC,
       F.AD_FIELD_ID,
       F.AD_REFERENCE_ID refid
  FROM ad_field f
       INNER JOIN ad_column c ON C.AD_COLUMN_ID = F.AD_COLUMN_ID
       INNER JOIN ad_tab tab ON TAB.AD_TAB_ID = F.AD_TAB_ID
       INNER JOIN ad_window w ON W.AD_WINDOW_ID = TAB.AD_WINDOW_ID
 WHERE F.AD_REFERENCE_ID = 30 AND F.ISDISPLAYED = 'Y'
ORDER BY W.NAME

name: repated checks in bankstatment.sql
content:
DECLARE
   v_c   NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
   FOR r IN (SELECT L.C_PAYMENT_ID,
                    P.CHECKNO,
                    P.C_BANKACCOUNT_ID,
                    P.DOCUMENTNO
               FROM    C_BANKSTATEMENTLINE l
                    INNER JOIN
                       C_PAYMENT p
                    ON P.C_PAYMENT_ID = L.C_PAYMENT_ID
              WHERE p.IsReceipt = 'N' AND L.C_BANKSTATEMENT_ID = 1000340)
   LOOP
      BEGIN
         SELECT COUNT (*)
           INTO v_c
           FROM C_Payment
          WHERE     IsReceipt = 'N'
                AND C_Payment_ID <> r.C_Payment_ID
                AND CheckNo = r.CheckNo
                AND C_BankAccount_ID = r.C_BankAccount_ID;
      EXCEPTION
         WHEN OTHERS
         THEN
            v_c := 0;
      END;

      IF (v_c > 0)
      THEN
         DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE ('AP Payment No = ' || r.documentno || ' - ID =' || r.C_PAYMENT_ID);
      END IF;
   END LOOP;
END;

name: sales view with new function.sql
content:
SELECT i.AD_CLIENT_ID, i.AD_ORG_ID, i.c_currency_id, U.AD_USER_ID, U.NAME salesrep,
         SUM (sumrep.TOTALLINES) totalrep, SUM (sumrep.grandtotal) grandrep,
         I.dateinvoiced, TO_CHAR (I.DATEINVOICED, 'YYYY') year, TO_CHAR (I.DATEINVOICED, 'Q') Quarter,
         TO_CHAR (I.DATEINVOICED, 'MM') Month, SUM (I.TOTALLINES) TOTALLINES, SUM (I.grandtotal) grandtotal
    FROM c_invoice i LEFT JOIN (SELECT ad_user_id, NAME FROM ad_user) u ON U.AD_USER_ID = I.SALESREP_ID
         INNER JOIN (SELECT c_doctype_id, NAME, docbasetype, ismemo FROM c_doctype) dt ON (dt.c_doctype_id = i.c_doctype_id)
         LEFT JOIN c_bpartner P ON P.C_BPARTNER_ID = I.C_BPARTNER_ID
   WHERE I.ISSOTRX = 'Y' AND dt.docbasetype = 'ARI' AND dt.ismemo = 'N' AND i.DOCSTATUS IN ('CO', 'CL')
GROUP BY i.AD_CLIENT_ID, i.AD_ORG_ID, i.c_currency_id, i.C_BPARTNER_ID, P.NAME, U.AD_USER_ID, I.DATEINVOICED, U.NAME

name: TOAD-SCHDUAL-WIZARD-TUTORIAL.txt
content:
For Toad for Oracle 10.0 and above:
1. Select Utilities | Automation Designer menu option
2. Select DB Misc tab from right side pane
3. Double click on Execute Script to add under Action list
4. Double click on Execute Script 1 action to open it
5. Select Text radio button and enter query statement
6. Under Output pane, designate the Output destination
7. Hit Apply and Cancel
8. Right click on Execute Script 1 action and hit Run
9. Right click on Execute Script 1 action and hit Schedule
10. Select Utilities | Task Scheduler menu option to view this job

SELECT ad_table.tablename, c_doc_v.documentno, ad_wf_activity.*
    FROM ad_wf_activity
         LEFT JOIN ad_table ON ad_table.ad_table_id = ad_wf_activity.ad_table_id
         LEFT OUTER JOIN c_doc_v ON C_DOC_V.RECORD_ID = ad_wf_activity.RECORD_ID
   WHERE ad_wf_activity.wfstate = 'OS' AND ad_table.tablename = 'C_Transfer'
ORDER BY ad_wf_activity.ad_table_id, c_doc_v.documentno
